sources.snippet: I Introduction Multi-modal generative AI (Artificial Intelligence) has received increasing attention recently with the advent of (multi-modal) large language models (LLMs) and diffusion models. Two typical models of multi-modal generative AI are GPT-4V [1] and Sora [2] from OpenAI, which have produced great impacts on both academia and industry.
